changed.statement: ¬ (∀ (n s : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), 3 ≤ n → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C → C.size ≤ s → PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C → PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost A (s + (2 * n - 5)))
changed.unlocks: settles this statement on the record; whichever side is proved is kept
changed.context: Truth unknown; our support is small cases only. An answer is one graph with n at least 3 and two circuits in one file: an AND/OR/NOT circuit of s gates right on the promise, and a proof that no AND/OR circuit of at most s + 2n - 5 gates is. The first place to look is side 3, where the bound is s + 1: a 3 by 3 graph that costs 6 with NOT gates and 8 or more without would answer it. We know of none. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
